idea-plugin.name: MR Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Review merge and pull requests of GitLab, GitHub and Bitbucket right in the IDE, with working code navigation and without generated noise.

  • Request list of the project with filters (all open, waiting for my review, assigned to me, mine, merged); repository switcher for folders with several repositories.
  • One-click checkout into a local mr/<number> branch; uncommitted changes are stashed and restored by "Go back".
  • Diff whose right side is the real project file — Ctrl+Click, Find Usages and the rest of the navigation work.
  • Hides generated files by suffixes you set (e.g. .pb.go) and folders that contain only such files.
  • Comments: line and multi-line threads, replies, resolve, suggestions, general comments; drafts submitted as one review; edit and delete your own; approve, request changes, merge, CI status.
  • Files viewed marks and +/− counts; discussion list that opens the diff at the commented line.

Works with gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab, github.com and GitHub Enterprise Server, Bitbucket Cloud and Bitbucket Data Center, several of them at once. English and Russian interface.
